[[Stinger]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] dropped by [[Gargash Thornbeard]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Grenth's Footprint]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while in a [[stance]])
:[[Marksmanship]] +1 (20% chance while using [[skill]]s)
:Lengthens [[Poison]] duration on foes by 33%

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Ivory Bow]].

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*[[Hornbow (weapon)|Hornbow]] from collector [[Peltsman Jiri]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Poisonous]] [[Bow String]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[Of Attribute|of Marksmanship]]
